title: Getting Wealthy vs. Staying Wealthy
coreMove: Choose survival over brilliance when one bad break can end the game.
sourcePressure: Getting wealthy may reward boldness, but keeping wealth depends on endurance, restraint, and enough margin to survive shocks.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating wealth-building and wealth-preservation as the same skill.
